responsibility: Implements the PowerPC-specific target hooks for the D front end. It registers D builtin version identifiers such as PPC/PPC64 and hard- versus soft-float variants, and answers __traits(getTargetInfo, ...) queries for target properties like float ABI and object format, providing the D language layer with rs6000-specific compile-time target introspection.
same_name_distinction: Implementation side of the rs6000-d pair: it contains the D front end hook logic for builtin version registration and getTargetInfo answers, while rs6000-d.h merely declares those functions and maps them onto TARGET_D_* macros.
